texts.preamble: Red Bull India Private Limited & Anr vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 13 July, 2016
texts.arguments: Mr. Mitra, learned senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners, submits that there is substantial compliance of Regulation 2.2.2:10(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Packaging and labelling Regulations, 2011 inasmuch as the declaration "best before...........months and years" were expressed in numerals and such label was, in fact, approved by the concerned authority under Food Safety and Standards Act (FSS Act). Mr. Banerjee, learned senior counsel appearing for the State, Red Bull India Private Limited & Anr vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 13 July, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14498101/ 1 submits that such permission was a qualified one which, inter alia, required compliance of all provisions relating to the general labelling. He further submits that Regulation 2.2.2:10(i) of the said Act 2 required the manufacturers to declare the 'month' and 'year' in "capital letters" thereby clearly indicating that it should be written in letters but not in numbers.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Mr. Mitra, learned senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners, submits that there is substantial compliance of Regulation 2.2.2:10(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Packaging and labelling Regulations, 2011 inasmuch as the declaration "best before...........months and years" were expressed in numerals and such label was, in fact, approved by the concerned authority under Food Safety and Standards Act (FSS Act). Mr. Banerjee, learned senior counsel appearing for the State, Red Bull India Private Limited & Anr vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 13 July, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14498101/ 1 submits that such permission was a qualified one which, inter alia, required compliance of all provisions relating to the general labelling. He further submits that Regulation 2.2.2:10(i) of the said Act 2 required the manufacturers to declare the 'month' and 'year' in "capital letters" thereby clearly indicating that it should be written in letters but not in numbers.
